summary: Iteration 12 tested the new Result > Solutions AI step-by-step block on the frontend, at a 375x667 viewport, logged in as 9000000001. The feature mostly works. Opening BITSAT Full Mock 01 (8501cf9c) calls GET /api/jl/attempts/{id}/ai-solutions once, which returns 142 of 142 ready. no-worked-solution-N shows 'The source provides this key only. An AI generated step-by-step solution is shown below.' ai-solution-N renders these sections: Concept, Given, Step-by-step (numbered 1..n), Final answer 'Option B ✓ matches the official key', Shortcut, Common mistakes, Time tip and Examiner insight, plus the difficulty pill (Easy/Moderate) and the disclosure line. Switching questions (Q1, Q2, Q5), all 5 subjects (Q31, Q61, Q71, Q91) and all 5 filters always showed the AI block for the right question, with no crash. Empty filters show solution-empty-filter. Regression on the JEE Main 'Units & Measurements' attempt (385dc381), where all 50 AI items are pending: the supplied solution-text still shows, and ai-solution-pending-N says 'being prepared'. No console errors there. Main issue: the web plainMath fallback leaves LaTeX artifacts. I ran the real plainMath over all 3156 strings of the 142 live solutions, and 332 (about 10.5%) still contain leftovers, for example 'K=frac12 mv^2', 'frac47', 'tfrac12', 'dfracF^2L2YA', 'fracbinom42binom51', 'P(Amid B)', 'Bsubseteq H', 'longrightarrow', 'xrightarrow', '20\\%', 'underbrace' and 'begin/end'. There are no raw $ signs. I also fixed one existing bug in the Analysis tab: Notice received several raw text children, which produced 'Unexpected text node' errors on web and would crash on native.

ui_bugs.issue: About 10.5% of AI solution strings (332 of 3156) still show LaTeX artifacts on web. (1) A \frac without braces, such as \frac12 or \frac47, shows as 'frac12'. 189 strings are affected. (2) \dfrac and \tfrac are not handled (35). (3) \frac{a^{2}}{b} with nested braces is not converted because ^{}/_{} are only replaced after the frac loop. (4) \binom (27), \mid, \cap, \subseteq, \varnothing, \neg, \longrightarrow, \xrightarrow{..}, \rightleftharpoons, \underbrace and \begin{..}/\end{..} come out as bare words. (5) Escapes like \% and '\ ' keep the backslash (95 strings). Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/AiSolution.tsx:12-19

integration_issues.issue: Minor. The fetch happens once per opening of the Solutions tab. However, Solutions is only mounted while tab==='solutions', so switching Analysis then Solutions refetches; I counted 2 calls. Cached data is shown immediately, so there is no flicker. This is acceptable, but it is not strictly 'once per result open'.

If GET ai-solutions fails, the error is ignored silently: AiSolution gets item=undefined and renders nothing, and no retry is shown. no-worked-solution then falls back to 'No worked solution was supplied.' This is fine, but there is no hint that the AI block failed to load.

react_native_issues.issue: In the Analysis tab, Notice received several raw string children: 'Main {score}/{max} · Bonus ...'. Notice only wraps them in <T> when typeof children === 'string', so they were raw text nodes inside a View. This printed 'Unexpected text node' console errors on web and causes a 'Text strings must be rendered within a <Text>' crash on native. I fixed it by passing a single template string. Reference: /app/frontend/app/result/[id].tsx:64

action_items: Make plainMath in src/components/AiSolution.tsx more robust. (a) Run the ^{}/_{}, \text and \mathrm replacements inside the frac loop, before the frac match, so nested braces resolve. (b) Handle \[dt]?frac{a}{b} and the brace-less forms \[dt]?frac(\d)(\d) and \frac\d{..}. (c) Add \binom{n}{k} → C(n,k). (d) Add these to SYM: mid '|', cap '∩', cup '∪', subseteq '⊆', subset '⊂', varnothing '∅', neg '¬', longrightarrow and xrightarrow '→', rightleftharpoons '⇌', leftharpoons '↽', kappa 'κ', ldots. (e) Strip \begin{..}/\end{..}, \underbrace and \overline. (f) Unescape \% → %, '\ ' → ' ', and \\ → newline. Then re-run /app/backend/tests/check_ai_solutions_math.py; it dumps the items to /tmp/ai_items.json so you can check against all 142 live solutions.
Optional: show a small retry or error hint when the ai-solutions fetch fails.
Optional: on native, KaTeX is loaded from cdn.jsdelivr. With no network, the WebView shows raw $...$, so consider bundling KaTeX or falling back to the plainMath Fallback when the CDN load fails.
critical_code_review_comments: AiSolution.tsx (native path): the html() template escapes text and loads KaTeX auto-render, and the delimiters come out correctly as \\( \\[ in the output JS. The WebView height starts at 600 and is updated through postMessage(scrollHeight+8), so there is a short height jump on first render. key_agrees===false shows a red warning; no live item has key_agrees false or a flag, so that branch is untested.
result/[id].tsx:119: useCached(`ai.${id}`, ..., persist=false) is correct, since a memory-only cache lets new AI solutions show on the next open. aiBy is memoised on ai.data.

result/[id].tsx:177: the no-worked-solution copy correctly switches on aiBy[q.id]?.state === 'ready'. For JEE Main (solution_kind != answer_key_only), the supplied solution-text is kept and the pending AI block appears below it.

rca_of_issue: plainMath's regexes only cover \frac{..}{..} with flat contents and a small SYM map. The catch-all \\([A-Za-z]+) → SYM[k] ?? k removes the backslash from unknown commands, so 'frac', 'binom', 'mid' and similar end up as bare words.
